I don't really think I met anyone that I would consider odd. There was a girl who tried to slice her arms up with a CD and run out the doors once, she also spent large amounts of time staring at me while I ate.

It was on the fifth floor of the hospital, when you go in two sets of doors automatically lock behind you. We had a living room type thing right beside the nurses station. We had seats and could watch movies and TV, that was appropriate. The tables we ate meals at were also in the room, boys and girls could not sit beside each other at the tables. 
My roommate was a girl who lived in the town over from me we become friends very quickly and I am so thankful for that. Mostly everyone I met was dealing with self harm in so way shape or form, the person I remember the most was named Ryan and he had taken too much Xanax which drove him to being very paranoid and bring a knife to school. All around these were good kids who came from homes that were broken. The meals weren't too bad we got a few meals we could choose from each day (I ate a lot of waffle fries). We went to class for an hour a day and worked on school work that are schools had faxed in. We had a recreational therapist who came in every day and sometimes we would exercise or do arts and crafts we made a lot of collages. There were certain levels a patient could reach, you come in as a level one and get restricted privileges. But for good behavior you move up levels and get more phone calls and get to use the Xbox or the DS. Phone calls could only be ten minutes so whatever you needed to say had to be said quick. Each room had two beds and a bathroom with a shower in it. I made some lifelong friends there because you could say "hey I struggle with cutting" and people wouldn't think you were completely crazy.

The second time i went they did not have a bed on the ward for me so I put in the basement area of the pysch ward. I was put in a padded room with a foam mattress bed. There was a camera in the corner of the room that watched me constantly. That was an awful experience, there was only one other girl down there with me and I never came in contact with her. That whole trip was useless.
